result.summary: Follow-up authoring only, continuing my prior bridge-repair role. Produced one new evidence patch, docs/validation/evidence/buildings-component-validation-2026-09-20/author-room-metadata-repair.patch (baseSha256 null), a unified diff over ONLY godot/scripts/core/save_owner_buildings.gd applied onto the supplied current bridge (candidate-save_owner_buildings-repaired.gd, which already carries my BUILDING_STATE pin). It implements exactly Astra disposition M2 and nothing else. Hunk 1 adds one typed constant Array[String] SOURCE_ROOM_TYPE_KEYS holding the eight protected keys in ordinal order (DORMITORY, PRIVATE_ROOM, KITCHEN, DINING, COMMON, INFIRMARY, PANTRY, CORRIDOR), placed immediately after the existing SOURCE_ROOM_TYPE_CORRIDOR pin; the eight integer ROOM_TYPE_* alias constants and their existing rooms_ok comparison block are untouched. Hunk 2 mirrors the state block: _source_state_refusal's tail now returns the new _source_room_type_refusal(), which pins the bridge's own key-array length against SOURCE_ROOM_TYPE_COUNT (8), then Buildings.Catalog.ROOM_TYPE.size() == 8, then per key has(key), typeof(id) == TYPE_INT and value == the exact expected ordinal 0..7, coercing only after the type check, and then returns _tier_two_refusal() so the existing source chain order (ordinal -> state -> room type -> tier two -> dictionary sizes -> building facts -> furniture facts) is preserved and still completes before gate 5 projection or any column indexing. All refusals use Section.REFUSE_METADATA with the unchanged METADATA_DETAIL_PREFIX literal; the distinct gate-7 prefix and its spacing are untouched. This is a bounded eight-iteration preflight over the compiled immutable dictionary reached through the existing Buildings preload, with no per-row allocation, no new preload, no live Buildings/Definitions/Directory construction, no float, and no duplicate/resize/serialisation. Per M3, the existing literal 16384/81920 child-extent comparisons and every other expression, docstring, constant and the 29 projection assignments are byte-preserved; no test, harness, doc or case-count change is included, since those remain Astra-owned. Patch body is 46 lines total across two hunks (hard bound 100, aim 50). Diff text is authored only; nothing was run, applied, imported, measured or verified here, and no engine-observed result is claimed.

diff --git a/godot/scripts/core/save_owner_buildings.gd b/godot/scripts/core/save_owner_buildings.gd
--- a/godot/scripts/core/save_owner_buildings.gd
+++ b/godot/scripts/core/save_owner_buildings.gd
@@ -157,3 +157,7 @@
 const SOURCE_ROOM_TYPE_PANTRY: int = 6
 const SOURCE_ROOM_TYPE_CORRIDOR: int = 7
+const SOURCE_ROOM_TYPE_KEYS: Array[String] = [
+	"DORMITORY", "PRIVATE_ROOM", "KITCHEN", "DINING",
+	"COMMON", "INFIRMARY", "PANTRY", "CORRIDOR",
+]
 ## The fact-row column ordinals and tier-two key order this bridge indexes through.
@@ -393,8 +397,33 @@ static func _source_state_refusal() -> SaveHeader.Refusal:
 		var state_id: Variant = Buildings.Catalog.BUILDING_STATE[key]
 		if typeof(state_id) != TYPE_INT or int(state_id) != ordinal:
 			return _refuse(Section.REFUSE_METADATA, "%s '%s' is not integer state ordinal %d"
 				% [METADATA_DETAIL_PREFIX, key, ordinal])
-	return _tier_two_refusal()
+	return _source_room_type_refusal()
+
+
+static func _source_room_type_refusal() -> SaveHeader.Refusal:
+	"""Gate 4: ALL EIGHT protected RoomType ordinals, from the compiled catalog dictionary.
+
+	The ROOM_TYPE_* alias pins above stay. Size, key existence and integer type are proven
+	before any id is coerced, so a renumbered or truncated ROOM_TYPE refuses METADATA here,
+	before gate 5 projects or indexes a single column.
+	"""
+	if SOURCE_ROOM_TYPE_KEYS.size() != SOURCE_ROOM_TYPE_COUNT:
+		return _refuse(Section.REFUSE_METADATA, "%s this bridge pins %d room type keys, not %d"
+			% [METADATA_DETAIL_PREFIX, SOURCE_ROOM_TYPE_KEYS.size(), SOURCE_ROOM_TYPE_COUNT])
+	if Buildings.Catalog.ROOM_TYPE.size() != SOURCE_ROOM_TYPE_COUNT:
+		return _refuse(Section.REFUSE_METADATA, "%s ROOM_TYPE holds %d room types, not %d"
+			% [METADATA_DETAIL_PREFIX, Buildings.Catalog.ROOM_TYPE.size(),
+				SOURCE_ROOM_TYPE_COUNT])
+	for ordinal: int in SOURCE_ROOM_TYPE_COUNT:
+		var key: String = SOURCE_ROOM_TYPE_KEYS[ordinal]
+		if not Buildings.Catalog.ROOM_TYPE.has(key):
+			return _refuse(Section.REFUSE_METADATA, "%s ROOM_TYPE has no '%s' key"
+				% [METADATA_DETAIL_PREFIX, key])
+		var room_id: Variant = Buildings.Catalog.ROOM_TYPE[key]
+		if typeof(room_id) != TYPE_INT or int(room_id) != ordinal:
+			return _refuse(Section.REFUSE_METADATA, "%s '%s' is not integer room ordinal %d"
+				% [METADATA_DETAIL_PREFIX, key, ordinal])
+	return _tier_two_refusal()
 
 
 static func _tier_two_refusal() -> SaveHeader.Refusal:
